description: This file is a PHP template used to render a server error page (HTTP 500). It sets a layout, defines sections for sub-header and main content, and dynamically outputs error message details and page content.

methods.name: layout
methods.description: Sets the layout template for the page, passing parameters such as title.

methods.name: page
methods.description: Retrieves a page object or resource based on a key, such as 'big-error'.

methods.name: section
methods.description: Defines a section of the template, such as 'sub-header' or 'content'.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Marks the end of a section in the template.

methods.name: raw
methods.description: Outputs raw, unescaped content, such as error title, code, and message.

methods.name: parseContent
methods.description: Parses and renders the page content dynamically.
